detail.title: Experimental Differentiation of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory and Physical Hysteresis
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates the experimental separation of autocatalytic chemical memory from physical hysteresis, synthesizing findings from reaction network theory and stoichiometric models.

detail.title: Experimental Foundations of Autocatalytic Chemical Memory
detail.summary: Analysis of autocatalytic reaction network subgraphs and stoichiometric conditions supporting history-dependent states distinguishable from simple physical hysteresis.
detail.reason: Synthesizing evidence for project proj-autocatalytic-memory-01 to establish a provisional notebook on autocatalytic chemical memory.
